decisions.reason: Removing the E and L cap-height scaling requirement does not alter the independently established baseline alignment of the two Vs with the E and L feet. The project-ending language supplies no new candidate-specific value modification or removal.
The E and L cap-height rule is independent of the required peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent. The source does not cancel or revise that alignment relationship.

The removal of the E and L cap-height scaling requirement does not change the selected champagne-gold finish, distribution, or material treatment. The source provides no material-specific modification.
